items.title: Blowing up the ideal of denominators of a regular meromorphic section makes that section a global regular section modulo the exceptional divisor
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file divisors.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma says that blowing up the ideal of denominators of a regular meromorphic section yields a morphism over which that section becomes a global regular section of the pullback bundle twisted by the exceptional divisor, cut out by an effective Cartier divisor D, so that the pullback bundle is the twist of the pullback of the original bundle by D minus the exceptional divisor (statement lines 9232-9248). The counted proof is short but complete: it observes that the blowing up is admissible, rephrases the claim as a statement about a regular section of a twisted bundle which determines the divisor uniquely, passes to an affine chart where the section is a quotient of nonzerodivisors and computes the denominator ideal, and then on each blowup chart rewrites the section as a quotient whose denominator is the chart element cutting out the exceptional divisor, identifying the divisor D as cut out by the resulting numerator (proof lines 9250-9286). It is H2: the rephrasing and the chart-by-chart computation are carried out in the counted span, with the cited inputs being the denominator ideal and blowup algebra statements.
